propositions: RunawayPaginationError subclasses RuntimeError instead of BackendPaginationStallError, placing it outside the core stall type hierarchy

fetch_snapshot's three enrichment re-raise clauses match on BackendPaginationStallError and miss Cloud's error, causing control to fall to the broad except Exception fail-open handlers that degrade silently
a stalled Cloud pagination cursor produces a degraded snapshot with missing parent/comment/issuelink data instead of propagating the stall error and aborting the pass
making RunawayPaginationError subclass BackendPaginationStallError instead of RuntimeError allows all three fetcher re-raise clauses to catch and propagate the stall
existing except RunawayPaginationError sites and except RuntimeError sites remain unaffected because RuntimeError stays in the error's MRO via BackendPaginationStallError's inheritance
